messages:
Noah: saw ~3h of missing aggregate-hours for a small EU tenant cohort after kafka leader shuffle. thinking a targeted recompute. any thoughts on fastpath vs normal routing?
Sofia: can we add a token-bucket instead of ripping into reserved pool? a recompute:fastpath bucket would let us cap damage.
Asha: agree. operator-exposed option: checkbox 'Fast path (use recompute:fastpath)' in console. default off. show cost+ETA.
Ravi: API detail: prefer header x-recompute-fastpath: 1 for infra callers and ?fastpath=true for console. need canonical precedence (header wins).
Noah: also need server-side guard: tenant must have allow_fastpath_recompute flag or 403. log which credential triggered it.
Sofia: infra: implement token-bucket weight 10 for fastpath and 1 for normal. if bucket empty -> enqueue with backoff or fallback to normal lane depending on allow_fallback.
Asha: UX: show a temporary quicktag on tenant page "fastpath running" and a link to a small ephemeral dashboard for the run (progress, p95 cpu, kv_cache_miss, est spend).
infra-bot: Job created rb-2025-02-21-1015, id=rb-6789012345, fastpath=true, bucket=recompute:fastpath
quota-bot: Est: 9k agg-units -> ~$14, tenant cap = $100. Fastpath tokens available: 40 -> allows ~4 concurrent shards.
Ravi: add prefetch=true by default for fastpath; reduce batch width to avoid cache thrash. Also emit recompute.run_meta in audit logs.
Sofia: add temporary SLI watch on dedicated-host-p95 and recompute_cpu_p95 for 90m; alert to #eng-sre on >6% regression.
Noah: canary (2 shards) started. will post cache-miss and spend after first batch.
Asha: landing UI PR with checkbox + cost modal behind FF, posting screenshots shortly.
Noah: canary looks good: cache_miss 4%, cpu +2%, proceeding to ramp to 4 concurrent. thanks all.
